patches.purpose: Optional TLS on the HTTP and gRPC listeners (Server.TLSCertFile, Server.TLSKeyFile) and in the internal gRPC client of workers (RPCClient.TLS, RPCClient.TLSCAFile, RPCClient.TLSServerName). Over TLS a worker sends its credential without FUNNEL_ALLOW_INSECURE_CREDENTIALS; without these settings Funnel behaves as v0.12.3.
patches.removal: A Funnel release that serves TLS on both listeners and lets the internal gRPC client verify a configured CA file without FUNNEL_ALLOW_INSECURE_CREDENTIALS.

patches.purpose: Per-task worker credentials. The server derives a Basic credential for each task from Server.WorkerCredentialKeyFile and stores it in the immutable Secret funnel-worker-credential-<task>, which the worker template mounts and RPCClient.CredentialFile reads. Such a credential may only get its own task, claim its execution and write its events.
patches.removal: A Funnel release that issues each worker a credential limited to its own task and authorizes GetTask, WriteEvent and ClaimExecution against that task.
